OPERATIONAL_COUNTY_RESULT_STABILITY.reason: The operational registry independently binds every county name and FIPS; discovery and selection must cover each binding.

COUNTY_BOUNDARY_ISOLATION.reason: Representative edge coverage could be sufficient only after the owner approves existing stable boundary points and adjacent-county expectations.

CONSUMER_RESULT_STABILITY.reason: No evidence authorizes extrapolating one county consumer result to the other package identities.

FALLBACK_BEHAVIOR_STABILITY.reason: One runtime-governed deterministic trigger could govern the shared fallback path, but no safe protected trigger/result pair is presently authorized.

ROUTE_AWARENESS_STABILITY.reason: Existing Talco and Goodrich route tests are governed offline inputs, but protected external-provider execution and exact visible results are not authorized.
